scripts.reinstall: rm -rf node_modules apps/*/node_modules packages/*/node_modules && node scripts/pnpm.mjs install
scripts.compile: node scripts/pnpm.mjs run build:core && node scripts/pnpm.mjs --filter agent-resume-panel run compile
scripts.install:local: node scripts/pnpm.mjs run compile && node scripts/pnpm.mjs --filter agent-resume-panel run package && node apps/extension/scripts/install-local.mjs
scripts.install:local-vscode: node scripts/pnpm.mjs run compile && node scripts/pnpm.mjs --filter agent-resume-panel run package && node apps/extension/scripts/install-local.mjs --editors=code --require-all
scripts.pack:desktop: node scripts/pnpm.mjs run build:core && node scripts/pnpm.mjs --filter @agent-resume/desktop run pack:mac
scripts.test:desktop: node scripts/pnpm.mjs --filter @agent-resume/desktop run test:mac-app && node scripts/pnpm.mjs --filter @agent-resume/desktop run test:node-pty && node scripts/pnpm.mjs --filter @agent-resume/desktop run test:doctor && node scripts/pnpm.mjs --filter @agent-resume/desktop run test:workbench-files
scripts.i18n:apply-patches: node scripts/apply-i18n-patches.mjs && node scripts/pnpm.mjs run merge:desktop-i18n
